## night-oven (overnight bakery - Heat)

Queue **once**. Klein identity still -> 18 x 5.00s LTX AV prints (last-frame continuity) -> **Save 90s film (MP4)**. Do not Queue a 90s denoise (121 frames = 1+8n per shot). Optional silent rehearsal: **video/silent/still-to-shot**. Optional host stitch: `bazelisk run //scripts:run-utility -- concat-shots --film night-oven --yes`.

18 x 121 frames @ 24 fps (LTX 1+8n) stitch under a 90.00s cap. US-safe local pack only. No score. Play/download: overlay, `ez_*_90s.html`, or studio-ui `/watch/<slug>`.

**Identity look:** A photoreal third-person bakery still at 2 a.m. A flour-dusted linen apron hangs on a steel bench in the foreground, unmarked mixer bowls and a dark oven mouth behind. Warm tungsten versus a sodium alley through one high window. Match a standing eyeline. 35mm-equivalent classic, framed for YouTube 16:9, empty of lettering, mild film grain, clean unmarked lens.

| Beat | Place | s1 | s2 | s3 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Oven | Heat rolls out | A tray slides in | The door shuts |
| 2 | Shut | The window shows sodium alley | A look at the alley | Back to the oven |
| 3 | Alley glance | Sodium light on steel | The apron is a pale shape | Hands check the door |
| 4 | Handle | The handle is too hot | A wait | The door opens again |
| 5 | Gold | Unmarked loaves, no brand | A tray slides out | The apron is dusted again |
| 6 | Dust | Cooling rack, unmarked | A loaf is set down | The alley window brightens |
Prompt enhance is **off** so authored text (recipe, script labels, ACE tags, or film shots) is encoded as written. Turn Enhance on only if you want the 4B rewriter.
